title: Public water supply.
officialText:
(a)Required capacity. Where the required capacity of potable water supply is available from street water mains at the site, every building shall be supplied from such mains.

(b)Power pumps. When power pumps are required in the water supply system of a building, they shall take their supply from the street water mains in the manner prescribed in reference standard RS-16.
